basic_details.job_title: Chandigarh Administration Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh (Chandigarh Administration) has announced 4 vacancies for the Executive Engineer (Civil) post on a deputation basis. Eligible candidates can apply through the offline application process by sending their applications through proper channel to the office of the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Room No.117, U.T on or before 24 November 2026, with the application process starting on 11 October 2026. qualification.details: Deputation Eligibility Criteria: | Officers under Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, Public Sector Undertakings, Recognized Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, Autonomous Bodies, or Statutory Organizations. Holding analogous post on regular basis in parent cadre or department; OR with 5 years regular service in posts in Pay Band-3 (Rs. 15600-39100) with Grade Pay of Rs. 6600 or equivalent. Essential Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute or degree of Associate Member of Institute of Engineering in Civil Engineering (AMIE enrolled up to 31.05.2013); and 10 years experience in the relevant field of Engineering in Government Sector. Desirable Qualification: Master's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute. Age Limit: Not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Period of Deputation: One year, which can be extended for a period of three years.

selection_process: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications and CVs accompanied by supporting certificates and documents by the selection committee. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation.

content_sections.text: Eligible and willing officers who can be spared immediately must forward their applications through proper channel in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) to the following address: Office of the Chief Engineer, Engineering Department, Union Territory, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Room No.117, U.T. Essential Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University/Institute or degree of Associate Member of Institute of Engineering in Civil Engineering (AMIE enrolled up to 31.05.2013); and 10 years experience in the relevant field of Engineering in Government Sector. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent. Cadre clearance, vigilance clearance, and integrity certificate (Annexure-II) certified by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent. Supporting certificates and documents in support of qualification and experience claimed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves the scrutiny of applications and CVs accompanied by supporting certificates and documents by the selection committee. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Executive Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Executive Engineer (Civil) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Level-11 as per the 7th CPC, with a salary range of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 208,700.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering or AMIE (enrolled up to 31.05.2013) along with 10 years of experience in the relevant field of Engineering in the Government Sector.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. Who are the eligible sending authorities and organizations?
faq.answer: Officers working under the Central Government, State Governments, UT Administrations, Public Sector Undertakings, Recognized Universities, Recognized Research Institutions, Autonomous Bodies, or Statutory Organizations are eligible.
